messages:
alex: hey @maria @jen ptal — I addressed the comments in PR #432 and pushed a follow-up. TL;DR: split the big test into two, moved the retry logic into RetryPolicy, added a small harness for the allocator test, and adjusted some timeouts. I left the commits clean/atomic; happy to squash if you want one commit. CI is re-running now: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/432 :pray:
maria: quick question — I noticed the test timeout bumped to 200ms. is that because of CI runners? could we keep it 150ms and add a retry/backoff instead?
alex: good catch. CI runners have a bit more jitter so I bumped to 200ms to avoid intermittent flakes while we iterate. I added a TODO in the test and a comment in RetryPolicy to revisit with a perf run. If you'd rather, I can switch to 150ms + exponential backoff in this PR instead.
jen: PTAL — I can grab this in ~2h, heads down on backfills right now.
ci-bot: CI: PR 432 — unit tests ✅, e2e-smoke ✅, coverage change -0.01% (expected). Logs: https://ci.internal.redwood/432
sam: I ran the unit suite locally and saw the same green. flakebot only flagged an unrelated infra transient. canary slot ok today if we want it.
maria: LGTM aside from a tiny commit message nit — please include the issue number and a "Fixes #<issue>" line so it links. Also can you add a one-line comment above the 200ms explaining it's for CI jitter?
alex: done — amended the last commit with "Fixes #987" and added the comment. rebased and force-pushed. I squashed the lint fix into the test split but left the two logical changes separate (test split + RetryPolicy). PTAL.
jen: glanced quickly, looks reasonable. approve from me.
maria: :thumbsup: approving now. will merge post-canary (scheduling at 16:00 PT).
sam: happy to handle the merge after canary if you want a steward.
alex: thanks all — adding release-note draft: "Fix allocator race in kv cache under burst; split allocator tests and add RetryPolicy to stabilize intermittent CI flakes."
jen: tiny nit for release note: s/kv cache/KV cache/ and maybe call out test split in parens. otherwise good.
alex: updated release note and pushed. thanks everyone!
